name: laidback-reviewer
description: PR review bot: reviews pull requests assigned to my account, proposes the review, and only sends it through a policy layer.

scripts.gate:check:docker: docker compose run --rm reviewer node src/cli/gate-check.mjs
scripts.test:docker: docker build -t laidback-reviewer . && docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/app/tests:ro" laidback-reviewer node --test --test-force-exit
scripts.test:compose: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/app/tests:ro" reviewer node --test --test-force-exit
scripts.gate:check:telegram:docker: docker compose run --rm reviewer node src/cli/telegram-check.mjs
